meta.title: Patterns
meta.note: Perfect periodic k-colour pattern types, k <= 6, as marked coloured orbifolds: colour group (catalogue D id) + based seat of the motif, up to affine equivalence.  Anchors: G&S Table 8.2.1 (colour-group counts), the 88 two-colour types of Figs 8.2.2/8.3.5, the 59 three-colour types of Figs 8.2.3/8.3.6.  Labels for k >= 4 are systematic extensions (no published tables exist).

pm.relations: P² = Q² = 1; αP = Pα; αQ = Qα
